description: Expanded, source-tracked foundation data for the Legends: Z-A Battle Advisor. The Lumiose regional-number map is populated for 001-232. Species forms and move coverage are partial; this is not yet a complete ZA learnset database.

pokemonAvailability.scope: All 232 Lumiose regional-number entries have at least one species/type record. The list also retains separate records for alternate forms in the supplementary community reference and one non-Lumiose-Dex Volcanion record.
pokemonAvailability.note: Regional coverage is complete by number; individual source-imported records have not all been independently rechecked.

forms.scope: Some mechanically distinct or listed forms appear as separate rows; selected flower, gender, pattern and size variants are grouped under availableForms. This is not an exhaustive form catalogue.

moves.scope: 29 move records with ZA power, base cooldown, distance, raw frame data and effects when listed in individual reference pages.

dataNotes: The species list is a work-in-progress reference. All 232 Lumiose regional numbers now have at least one record, but source-imported species/type/form records are not all individually cross-checked.

Community data was used only as a supplementary name/form/type/number reference. Descriptions, images, catch-rate calculations and stat blocks from the community file were not copied into this catalog; the repository does not declare a license.
Forms can have different statistics or type combinations. Do not collapse an alternate form onto a base form when the form affects battle behavior.
Cooldown values are the base cooldown listed by the source. In-battle cooldown can be modified by Speed and certain effects; do not present base cooldown as a guaranteed timer.
Distances and frame counts are stored as the reference reports them. Do not infer exact hitbox geometry or convert frames to seconds until the game timing basis is verified.
A move in this catalog is not proof a Pokémon can learn it in ZA. The owning Pokémon's ZA learnset or the user's recorded moveset must be checked before recommending that move.

The move catalog is a curated slice, not the full move roster. The current community index flags incomplete identification of Mega Dimension version 2.0.0 additions; DLC moves and forms require additional verification.
Volcanion is retained as a non-Lumiose-Dex community-reference entry with lumioseDex null. Its in-game availability needs confirmation before it is shown as normally obtainable.

sources.scope: Used as a secondary index, not treated as a complete source for all forms or learnsets.

sources.name: PokeZACatchCalc community reference data

sources.scope: Community repository has no declared license. Only concise factual metadata fields were used; its descriptions, images, stat blocks, and calculations were not copied. Imported entries remain marked as not individually rechecked.

sources.scope: Individual source URLs are recorded on each move. Values should be rechecked after major game updates.

sources.supports: General real-time battle behavior, movement and recalling Pokémon to avoid attacks.
sources.scope: General game-behavior reference; not used as a move-stat table.
